|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">ベイダーとオビ＝ワンが同じ位置カード上にいる時に使う。1フォース消費して決闘を行う。ライト・セーバーを持っているジェダイは戦闘値が＋2される。敗者は除外カードとなり、残りのゲームの間、同じ人物を表すカードは配備できなくなる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ベイダーとオビ＝ワン・ケノービは、デス・スターのハンガー・ベイ327付近にてライトセーバーで最期の決闘を行った。「修行半ばで貴様の下を去ったが、今やすべてを極めた。」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' The Time Has Finally Come to Settle This.

'''Card text:''' Use when Vader and Obi-Wan are at the same site. Use 1 Force to duel. A Jedi with a lightsaber adds 2 to their duel total. The loser is placed out of play, and cards representing the same person cannot deploy for the rest of the game.

'''Lore:''' Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi fought their final lightsaber duel near Death Star Hangar Bay 327. “I left you before my training was complete, but now I have mastered everything.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title paraphrases the English title as the time to settle the matter.
|notes='''The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese Reflections III Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[The Circle Is Now Complete|The Circle Is Now Complete]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty]] in October 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[The Circle Is Now Complete (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R41 at rarity VR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 31, Reflections III foil cards, R41.
